layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Dinosaur beak morphology
features: Extreme close-up profile of a dinosaur's snout
A prominent, curved 'parrot-like' beak made of smooth, hardened clay
The beak is toothless and has a sharp, clean edge for shearing plants or cracking eggs
Soft teal or orange clay skin texture with gentle creases near the beak base
Friendly, toy-like aesthetic with soft lighting
layer_3_action.action: A side-profile macro shot focusing on the beak of an Oviraptor-style dinosaur. An extreme closeup of the beak is the central focus, showing its distinct hooked shape and smooth texture. The background is a soft, warm-toned desert landscape with blurred clay dunes. No text.
